patch:
diff --git a/boltons/fileutils.py b/boltons/fileutils.py
index 5562d91..8dc1c85 100644
--- a/boltons/fileutils.py
+++ b/boltons/fileutils.py
@@ -404,7 +404,16 @@ class AtomicSaver:
         else:
             self.part_path = os.path.join(self.dest_dir, self.part_filename)
         self.mode = 'w+' if self.text_mode else 'w+b'
-        self.open_flags = _TEXT_OPENFLAGS if self.text_mode else _BIN_OPENFLAGS
+        self.open_flags = 0
+        if self.mode == 'w':
+            self.open_flags |= os.O_WRONLY
+        elif self.mode == 'a':
+            self.open_flags |= os.O_APPEND
+        elif self.mode == 'r+':
+            self.open_flags |= os.O_RDWR
+        else:
+            # Default to read/write
+            self.open_flags |= os.O_RDWR
 
         self.part_file = None
